question: World Health Organisation (WHO) is headquartered in__________. (RRB NTPC CBT-I (11/01/2021) Shift 2)
options: Amsterdam, Netherlands
Geneva, Switzerland
Vienna, Austria
New York City, America
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Geneva, Switzerland

Explanation:
The World Health Organization (WHO) is a specialized agency of the United Nations responsible for international public health. Its headquarters is located in Geneva, Switzerland. WHO was established on 7 April 1948, and this day is celebrated annually as World Health Day. The primary goal of the organization is to achieve the highest possible level of health for all people. WHO plays a crucial role in disease surveillance, pandemic response, health policy development, and coordination of health research.

Important one-liners for upcoming exams:
☛ WHO headquarters → Geneva, Switzerland
☛ WHO establishment date → 7 April 1948
☛ Current WHO Director-General → Dr. Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus
☛ WHO predecessors → International Office of Public Hygiene and League of Nations Health Organization
☛ WHO member countries → 194 member states
question_hi: विश्व स्वास्थ्य संगठन (WHO) का मुख्यालय __________ में है। (RRB NTPC CBT-I (11/01/2021) Shift 2)
options_hi: एम्स्टर्डम, नीदरलैंड
जिनेवा, स्विट्जरलैंड
वियना, ऑस्ट्रिया
न्यूयॉर्क शहर, अमेरिका
solution_hi:
Solution: सही उत्तर है जिनेवा, स्विट्जरलैंड

Explanation:
विश्व स्वास्थ्य संगठन (WHO) संयुक्त राष्ट्र की एक विशेष एजेंसी है जो अंतर्राष्ट्रीय सार्वजनिक स्वास्थ्य से संबंधित है। इसका मुख्यालय जिनेवा, स्विट्जरलैंड में स्थित है। WHO की स्थापना 7 अप्रैल 1948 को हुई थी और यह दिन प्रतिवर्ष विश्व स्वास्थ्य दिवस के रूप में मनाया जाता है। संगठन का प्राथमिक उद्देश्य सभी लोगों के लिए उच्चतम संभव स्वास्थ्य स्तर प्राप्त करना है। WHO रोग निगरानी, महामारी प्रतिक्रिया, स्वास्थ्य नीति विकास और स्वास्थ्य अनुसंधान के समन्वय में महत्वपूर्ण भूमिका निभाता है।

Important one-liners for upcoming exams:

☛ WHO की सदस्य संख्या → 194 सदस्य देश

question: ISRO has established the _______, at Bharati station, Antarctica, for receiving IRS data.  (RRB NTPC CBT-I (12/01/2021) Shift 1)
options: NCAOR
NRSC
AGEOS
IMGEOS
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is AGEOS

Explanation:
ISRO has established the AGEOS (Antarctic Ground Station for Earth Observation Satellites) at Bharati station, Antarctica, for receiving IRS (Indian Remote Sensing Satellite) data. This station enables continuous data reception from earth observation satellites in polar regions. AGEOS is operated by NRSC (National Remote Sensing Centre). Due to its location in Antarctica, it provides better coverage for polar-orbiting satellites. NCAOR (National Centre for Antarctic and Ocean Research) is not related to this station. IMGEOS is not a valid station. Hence, the correct option is AGEOS.

Important one-liners for upcoming exams:
☛ What is the full form of AGEOS? → Antarctic Ground Station for Earth Observation Satellites
☛ Which organization operates AGEOS? → NRSC (National Remote Sensing Centre)
☛ Where is AGEOS located? → Bharati station, Antarctica
☛ What is the purpose of AGEOS? → To receive IRS (Indian Remote Sensing Satellite) data
☛ What is the full form of NCAOR? → National Centre for Antarctic and Ocean Research
question_hi: ISRO ने IRS आंकड़े प्राप्त करने के लिए भारती केंद्र , अंटार्कटिका में _______ की स्थापना की है। (RRB NTPC CBT-I (12/01/2021) Shift 1)
options_hi: NCAOR
NRSC
AGEOS
IMGEOS
solution_hi:
Solution: सही उत्तर है AGEOS

Explanation:
ISRO ने अंटार्कटिका में भारती केंद्र पर AGEOS (Antarctic Ground Station for Earth Observation Satellites) की स्थापना की है। इसका उद्देश्य IRS (Indian Remote Sensing Satellite) डेटा प्राप्त करना है। यह स्टेशन ध्रुवीय क्षेत्रों में पृथ्वी अवलोकन उपग्रहों से लगातार डेटा प्राप्त करने में सक्षम बनाता है। AGEOS का संचालन NRSC (National Remote Sensing Centre) द्वारा किया जाता है। यह स्टेशन अंटार्कटिका में स्थित होने के कारण ध्रुवीय कक्षा वाले उपग्रहों से बेहतर कवरेज प्रदान करता है। NCAOR (National Centre for Antarctic and Ocean Research) से संबंधित नहीं है। IMGEOS कोई मान्य स्टेशन नहीं है। इस प्रकार, सही विकल्प AGEOS है।

☛ AGEOS कहाँ स्थित है? → भारती केंद्र, अंटार्कटिका
☛ AGEOS का उद्देश्य क्या है? → IRS (Indian Remote Sensing Satellite) डेटा प्राप्त करना
☛ NCAOR का पूरा नाम क्या है? → National Centre for Antarctic and Ocean Research

question: Which of the following is the correct full form of 'MRTP' in MRTP Act 1969? (RRB NTPC CBT-I (12/01/2021) Shift 1)
options: Money Reservation Trade Policy Act
Money Reservation Trade Practices Act
Monopolies and Restrictive Trade Practices Act
Monopolies Reservation Trade Practices Act
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Monopolies and Restrictive Trade Practices Act

Explanation:
The full form of MRTP in the MRTP Act 1969 is Monopolies and Restrictive Trade Practices Act. This act was enacted in India to prevent monopolies and restrictive trade practices, and to promote competition. It aimed to control the concentration of economic power. The MRTP Act was replaced by the Competition Act, 2002, which established the Competition Commission of India (CCI) as the regulator.

Important one-liners for upcoming exams:
☛ When was MRTP Act enacted? → 1969
☛ What is the full form of MRTP Act? → Monopolies and Restrictive Trade Practices Act
☛ Which act replaced MRTP Act? → Competition Act, 2002
☛ What was the main objective of MRTP Act? → Prevent monopolies and restrictive trade practices
☛ Who is the competition regulator in India? → Competition Commission of India (CCI)

options_hi: मनी रिज़र्वेशन ट्रेड पॉलिसी एक्ट
मनी रिज़र्वेशन ट्रेड प्रेक्टिस एक्ट
मोनोपोलिस एंड रिस्टृक्टिव ट्रेड प्रेक्टिस एक्ट

Solution: सही उत्तर है मोनोपोलिस एंड रिस्टृक्टिव ट्रेड प्रेक्टिस एक्ट

Explanation:
MRTP Act 1969 का पूरा नाम Monopolies and Restrictive Trade Practices Act है। यह भारत में एकाधिकार और प्रतिबंधात्मक व्यापार प्रथाओं को नियंत्रित करने के लिए बनाया गया था। इस अधिनियम का उद्देश्य आर्थिक शक्ति के संकेंद्रण को रोकना और प्रतिस्पर्धा को बढ़ावा देना था। 2002 में इस अधिनियम को Competition Act से प्रतिस्थापित कर दिया गया।

☛ MRTP Act को किस अधिनियम ने प्रतिस्थापित किया? → Competition Act, 2002

question: Which one country of the following was not a part of former USSR? (RRB NTPC CBT-I (12/01/2021) Shift 1)
options: Moldova
Georgia
Finland
Russia
solution:
Solution: The correct answer is Finland

Explanation:
The former USSR (Union of Soviet Socialist Republics) was a federation of 15 republics that existed from 1922 to 1991. It included Russia, Ukraine, Belarus, Moldova, Georgia, Armenia, Azerbaijan, Kazakhstan, Uzbekistan, Turkmenistan, Kyrgyzstan, Tajikistan, Latvia, Lithuania, and Estonia. Finland was never part of the USSR; it remained an independent country, although it shared a border with the Soviet Union and fought wars during World War II. Both Moldova and Georgia were Soviet republics. Russia was the largest and dominant republic of the USSR. Therefore, Finland is the correct answer.

Important one-liners for upcoming exams:
☛ When was the USSR formed? → 30 December 1922
☛ When did the USSR dissolve? → 26 December 1991
☛ Who was the last leader of the USSR? → Mikhail Gorbachev
☛ Which was the largest Soviet republic? → Russia
☛ Who was the first leader of the USSR? → Lenin (as head of the Soviet state)
question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा देश पूर्व सोवियत संघ का हिस्सा नहीं था? (RRB NTPC CBT-I (12/01/2021) Shift 1)
options_hi: मोल्दोवा
जॉर्जिया
फिनलैंड
रूस
solution_hi:
Solution: सही उत्तर है फिनलैंड

Explanation:
पूर्व सोवियत संघ (USSR) 15 गणराज्यों का एक संघ था जो 1922 से 1991 तक अस्तित्व में रहा। इसमें रूस, यूक्रेन, बेलारूस, मोल्दोवा, जॉर्जिया, आर्मेनिया, अजरबैजान, कजाकिस्तान, उज्बेकिस्तान, तुर्कमेनिस्तान, किर्गिस्तान, ताजिकिस्तान, लातविया, लिथुआनिया और एस्टोनिया शामिल थे। फिनलैंड कभी भी USSR का हिस्सा नहीं रहा; यह एक स्वतंत्र देश था, हालांकि इसने सोवियत संघ के साथ सीमा साझा की और द्वितीय विश्व युद्ध के दौरान युद्ध लड़ा। मोल्दोवा और जॉर्जिया दोनों सोवियत गणराज्य थे। रूस USSR का सबसे बड़ा और प्रमुख गणराज्य था। अतः फिनलैंड सही विकल्प है।

Important one-liners for upcoming exams:
☛ USSR का गठन कब हुआ? → 30 दिसंबर 1922
☛ USSR का विघटन कब हुआ? → 26 दिसंबर 1991
☛ USSR के अंतिम राष्ट्रपति कौन थे? → मिखाइल गोर्बाचेव
☛ सबसे बड़ा सोवियत गणराज्य कौन सा था? → रूस
☛ USSR के पहले राष्ट्रपति कौन थे? → लेनिन (सोवियत संघ के प्रमुख के रूप में)

question: When was WTO (World Trade Organization) established? (RRB NTPC CBT-I (12/01/2021) Shift 1)
options: 1995
1948
1999
1983
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is 1995.

Explanation:
The World Trade Organization (WTO) was established on January 1, 1995. It succeeded the General Agreement on Tariffs and Trade (GATT), which was formed in 1948. The WTO is an international organization that regulates global trade rules, resolves trade disputes, and provides a platform for trade negotiations. Its headquarters is located in Geneva, Switzerland. Member countries of the WTO agree to reduce trade barriers and promote fair trade practices. Currently, the WTO has 164 member nations.

Important one-liners for upcoming exams:
☛ Establishment date of WTO → January 1, 1995
☛ Headquarters of WTO → Geneva, Switzerland
☛ Predecessor of WTO → GATT (1948)
☛ Total WTO member countries → 164
☛ Main objective of WTO → Liberalize international trade and resolve disputes
question_hi: विश्व व्यापार संगठन (WTO) की स्थापना कब हुई थी? (RRB NTPC CBT-I (12/01/2021) Shift 1)
options_hi: 1995
1948
1999
1983
solution_hi:
Solution: सही उत्तर है 1995।

Explanation:
विश्व व्यापार संगठन (WTO) की स्थापना 1 जनवरी 1995 को हुई थी। यह गैट (GATT) का उत्तराधिकारी है, जो 1948 में स्थापित हुआ था। WTO एक अंतरराष्ट्रीय संगठन है जो वैश्विक व्यापार नियमों को नियंत्रित करता है, व्यापार विवादों को सुलझाता है, और व्यापार वार्ता के लिए मंच प्रदान करता है। इसका मुख्यालय जिनेवा, स्विट्जरलैंड में है। WTO के सदस्य देश व्यापार बाधाओं को कम करने और निष्पक्ष व्यापार को बढ़ावा देने के लिए समझौते करते हैं। वर्तमान में इसके 164 सदस्य देश हैं।

Important one-liners for upcoming exams:
☛ WTO की स्थापना तिथि → 1 जनवरी 1995
☛ WTO का मुख्यालय → जिनेवा, स्विट्जरलैंड
☛ WTO का पूर्ववर्ती संगठन → GATT (1948)
☛ WTO के वर्तमान सदस्य देशों की संख्या → 164
☛ WTO का प्रमुख उद्देश्य → अंतरराष्ट्रीय व्यापार को उदार बनाना और विवादों का समाधान करना

question_hi: राष्ट्रीय सूचना विज्ञान केंद्र (NIC) की स्थापना कब की गई थी? (RRB NTPC CBT-I (12/01/2021) Shift 1)

1976

question: Aadhaar is a 12-digit unique number that is issued by the _______. (RRB NTPC CBT-I (13/01/2021) Shift 1)
options: Unique Indian Digital Authority of India
Unique Indian Demographic Association of India
Unique Identification Association of India
Unique Identification Authority of India
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Unique Identification Authority of India (UIDAI)

Explanation:
Aadhaar is a 12-digit unique identification number issued by the Unique Identification Authority of India (UIDAI). It is a statutory body established under the Aadhaar Act 2016 by the Government of India. The UIDAI aims to provide a unique identity to residents of India, based on their biometric and demographic data. Aadhaar is used for accessing government schemes, subsidies, digital transactions, and various services. It is a key component of the Digital India initiative, ensuring efficient and transparent delivery of benefits.

☛ Full form of UIDAI → Unique Identification Authority of India
☛ When was the Aadhaar Act passed? → 2016
☛ How many digits are in Aadhaar? → 12

☛ What type of identity is Aadhaar? → Biometric and demographic
question_hi: आधार एक 12-अंकीय विशिष्ट संख्या है जो _______ द्वारा जारी की जाती है। (RRB NTPC CBT-I (13/01/2021) Shift 1)

question: What is the full form of UNDP? (RRB NTPC CBT-I (13/01/2021) Shift 2)

solution:

Explanation:
The full form of UNDP is United Nations Development Programme. It is the global development network of the United Nations, established in 1965. Its headquarters is in New York, USA. The main goal of UNDP is to eradicate poverty, reduce inequalities, and promote sustainable development. It provides policy advice, institutional capacity building, and partnership support to countries. UNDP publishes the Human Development Index (HDI) through its annual Human Development Report. It is part of the United Nations Development Group and operates in over 170 countries. UNDP plays a key role in achieving the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs).

question: Name the first country of the Soviet Republic (USSR) to declare its independence. (RRB NTPC CBT-I (13/01/2021) Shift 2)
options: Moldova
Lithuania
Ukraine
Georgia
solution:

The declaration marked a significant step in the collapse of the USSR, which officially dissolved on 26 December 1991.

The United Nations specialized agency that promotes international labour rights is the International Labour Organization (ILO). It was established in 1919 under the Treaty of Versailles and is headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland. The ILO aims to protect workers' rights, promote decent employment, and enhance social justice. It sets international labour standards covering working hours, minimum wages, occupational safety, and prohibition of child labour. In 1946, it became the first specialized agency of the United Nations. In contrast, IMO deals with maritime safety, ICAO with civil aviation, and IMF with economic stability.

question: The states of Maharashtra and Gujarat were created in _________. (RRB NTPC CBT-I (16/01/2021) Shift 1)
options: 1962
1959
1961
1960
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is 1960

Explanation:
The states of Maharashtra and Gujarat were formed on May 1, 1960. This resulted from the partition of the then Bombay State. Bombay State included primarily Marathi-speaking and Gujarati-speaking regions. Due to increasing demands for linguistic reorganization, the Bombay Reorganisation Act, 1960 was passed. question: _______ was India's first indigenously made film in colour. (RRB NTPC CBT-I (16/01/2021) Shift 1)

question: In which year was the first radio programme broadcast in India? (RRB NTPC CBT-I (16/01/2021) Shift 1)
options: 1936
1930
1957
1923
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is 1923

Explanation:
The first radio broadcast in India took place in 1923 in Bombay (now Mumbai). It was initiated by the Radio Club of Bombay, which operated a temporary studio from the then Presidency Magazine. Following this, the Indian Broadcasting Company (IBC) was formed in 1927, which was later taken over by the government. In 1936, All India Radio (AIR) was established, which continues to provide broadcasting services. This first broadcast is considered a milestone in Indian radio history. Thus, 1923 is the year of the first radio programme in India.

question: In the year ________ the Suez Canal was opened and this further strengthened Bombay's link with the world economy. (RRB NTPC CBT-I (16/01/2021) Shift 1)
options: 1888

1869
1896
solution:

Explanation:
The Suez Canal was opened in the year 1869. This canal connects the Mediterranean Sea to the Red Sea, significantly shortening the sea route between Europe and Asia. Its opening made the port of Bombay (now Mumbai) even more important, as it revolutionized the transport of goods from India to Europe. This strengthened Bombay's link with the world economy. The canal was built under the leadership of French engineer Ferdinand de Lesseps. Located in Egypt, the Suez Canal remains a vital artery for global trade even today.
